$comment: Cross-language show_if/required_if/option-enable_if semantics (v1: plain FieldMap conditions only — a map {fieldKey: scalar-or-list}; multiple keys = AND, list = OR-within-field. v2 adds the combinators {any:[cond,...]} (OR), {all:[cond,...]} (AND), {not: cond} (negation), evaluated with THREE-VALUED KLEENE logic: each condition is TRUE / FALSE / UNKNOWN, and the public matches() coerces only definite TRUE to true (FALSE and UNKNOWN both => safe false). A combinator object holds exactly one of any/all/not and no field keys (mixing => safe false); any/all take a non-empty list. Kleene: OR is TRUE if any sub TRUE else UNKNOWN if any UNKNOWN else FALSE; AND is FALSE if any sub FALSE else UNKNOWN if any UNKNOWN else TRUE; NOT swaps TRUE/FALSE and leaves UNKNOWN. This generalizes v1 exactly — a flat FieldMap's top-level result is unchanged. `not` is FORBIDDEN in show_if (lint) to keep the monotone visibility fixpoint; it is allowed in required_if / option enable_if, which are evaluated after the fixpoint converges. Pinned implementations: collimate.config_values.{canon,matches,compute_visibility,field_visible,effective_required,enabled_options,invalid_option_violations,validate_config} (SDK, source of truth); frontend setYaml.ts; renderer schema_form main.tsx (exported evaluator). canon() is TYPE-AWARE — the referent field's declared type picks the coercion domain (checkbox -> 'true'/'false' via truthy fold; number -> numeric; dropdown -> YAML-1.1 bool-word fold + case-fold + str; text/textarea/list/object are ILLEGAL referents). Each surface must run its OWN ingestion first (renderer: coerceValue over values_renderer; frontend: effectiveValues-style raw values from values_raw or values; server: parse_set_yaml resolution) so the string/bool/number domain divergence is exercised, not bypassed. Visibility is a monotone fixpoint starting ALL-HIDDEN; a hidden or absent referent contributes UNKNOWN and UNKNOWN never satisfies a match. Hidden field => never gates (not in missing_required, no option checks, no validation). Option enable_if is evaluated AFTER the visibility fixpoint converges against the same visible map (options never feed back into visibility); UNKNOWN referent => option DISABLED (safe polarity); a resolved value equal to a currently-disabled option of a VISIBLE field is an invalid_option violation; hidden fields contribute no option violations. eval_cases keys: cond, values (domain-neutral) / values_raw (frontend+server raw) / values_renderer (renderer post-coerceValue), optional referent_hidden (list of referents to treat as hidden), match (expected bool). gate_cases: fields+values -> blocking_empties (keys in missing_required). option_cases: fields+values -> enabled (per asserted dropdown field, the list of enabled option values) and invalid_options (list of {key,value}). Update THIS table first, then every implementation.

eval_cases.note: YAML-1.1: bare 'on' operand and live checkbox both canon to 'true' under checkbox type; renderer coerceValue(checkbox)->bool matches too
DROPDOWN domain divergence: server/frontend hold bool true, renderer holds string 'true'; _enum_canon folds both to 'true'. This is the case a flat fixture would miss.
numeric canon: string '0' and int 0 equal under number type
multi-key => AND
absent referent => UNKNOWN => no match (NOT canon('')='' equality)
referent present with matching value BUT hidden => UNKNOWN => no match. Distinguishes hidden from absent (both UNKNOWN) and pins the hidden-referent rule.
v2 any: OR across subconditions — a sub matches
v2 any: no sub matches, all referents known => FALSE
v2 any Kleene: one sub TRUE, other UNKNOWN (hidden) => TRUE (TRUE dominates OR)
v2 any Kleene: one sub FALSE (known != gemini), other UNKNOWN (hidden) => UNKNOWN => safe false
v2 all: AND across subconditions — both match
v2 all: AND — a sub fails
v2 all Kleene: TRUE and UNKNOWN (hidden) => UNKNOWN => safe false
v2 all Kleene: FALSE and UNKNOWN => FALSE (FALSE dominates AND)
v2 not: inner referent known and != gemini => inner FALSE => not => TRUE
v2 not: inner TRUE => not => FALSE
v2 not Kleene: NOT of UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN => safe false. A hidden referent never flips a not-condition true (banned in show_if by lint; safe here anyway)
v2 any with a checkbox sub — checkbox truthy fold inside a combinator
v2 nested any/all: the OR-across-fields 'auth=claude_code valid' shape — oneshot+claude backend satisfies the all branch
v2 nested: oneshot but non-claude backend => all branch fails and claude-terminal branch fails => FALSE
v2 nested: the claude-terminal branch satisfies regardless of backend
v2 malformed: a combinator key mixed with a field key => safe false
v2 malformed: any operand must be a list => safe false
v2 malformed: empty any list => safe false

gate_cases.note: hidden => never in blocking_empties even though required
transitive: B hidden => C hidden even though C's show_if matches B's STORED value (UNKNOWN via fixpoint)
cycle reaching runtime unlinted => both hidden => no gate (fixpoint starts all-hidden)

option_cases.note: enable_if met, option selected -> enabled, no violation
enable_if unmet + option SELECTED -> invalid_option blocks
enable_if unmet + option NOT selected -> greyed only, no violation
field hidden (show_if unmet) -> ALL option checks skipped, disabled+selected does NOT gate
canon domain: enable_if references a checkbox with YAML-1.1 'on' string operand; live value bool true matches
UNKNOWN referent (referent field hidden) -> option DISABLED (safe polarity); selected -> invalid_option
